svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 10 OF 10 • DOMAIN: MULTI-METHOD MASTERY & DAILY FLUENCY • 60x +10 QUARTER-BLOCK TOKENS • SOCKETS 1–10 & 100
DAILY PROTOCOL: 10 QUESTIONS, 2 WAYS & THE 100 MASTERY TOWER
How to Use Your SC-6 Quest Scoreboard with Daily Practice & Left-Shift [C] (?) Tutorial Mode
Grades 3–8 Daily Math Fluency • Hands-On Classroom & Home STEM Studio Series

text.tspan: Can you verify your textbook
calculation using physical blocks or
the SC-6 RPN stack to earn a second
+10 token?
Place the Scoreboard Lid on your desk beside your worksheet.
When you solve Question 1 using your first method (Textbook,
Blocks, or SC-6), seat one +10 token into Socket [1].
Work through Sockets [1] to [10] at your own pace!
Pick any question and check it a SECOND way:
• Built it with blocks? Check with SC-6 RPN keystrokes!
• Solved by hand? Prove it with Prime or Fraction blocks!
Notice: Stack a 2nd +10 token right on top (= +20 pts)!
3. TRADE 10 TOKENS FOR 100: Every 10 tokens (100 points), stack them into a 10-block tower in Socket
4. LAUNCH SC-6 QUEST MODE: Press Left-Shift [f] then [C] (?) matching the Question Mark in a Circle
socket.
Calculator Verification: Press Question Mark in a Circle Tutorial Icon ([f][?]) and run 8 [ENTER] 2 [+] 5

g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: WHY TWO WAYS BEATS ROTE DRILL

text.tspan: Students who think they are 'bad at math' gain immediate confidence when physical blocks,
textbook steps, and the SC-6 calculator all land on the exact same answer. Every 2-block stack
on your scoreboard is physical proof that mathematics is consistent and discoverable!

g.text: ★ EXTENSION INVESTIGATION: EARN A 200-POINT DOUBLE MASTERY DAY

text.tspan: Solve all 10 daily problems using your 1st Way (100 pts), then verify 10 problems using a 2nd
Way to stack 20 tokens (200 pts total)!

g.text: → Assemble with your physical blocks, then scan the QR code to verify with the 3D step-by-step vector model.
